candidats.description: Departure of English Mail from Post Office, Simla; Lala Deen Dayal (Indian, 1844 - 1905); 1885–1887; Albumen silver print; 19.7 × 26.2 cm (7 3/4 × 10 5/16 in.); 84.XM.1409.1; No Copyright - United States ( http://rightsstatements.org/vocab/NoC-US/1.0/ ) View of the Mall Road, a busy road lined with buildings and storefronts. At the end of the road is the Shimla General Post Office, a three-story building with railings along its balconies. A section of the building is topped with a spire-like structure. A number of people can be seen at various points along the road. (Recto, print) lower left,

candidats.titre: File:Copped Hall first floor room, Epping, Essex, England.jpg
candidats.description: A first floor room at Copped Hall , aka Copt Hall or Copthall, a Grade II listed country house , 1.5 miles (2 km) west from the town of Epping , Essex , England. The house and its ancillary buildings are within the civil parish of Epping Upland , with the larger part of the gardens to the west, in Waltham Abbey . The present mid-18th-century Georgian hall replaced an earlier Elizabethan hall by Sir Thomas Heneage . It was destroyed by fire in 1917, with it and its gardens suffering further 20th-century destruction and neglect. The property is being restored by The Copped Hall Trust . Mobile de

candidats.titre: File:Flickr - Official U.S. Navy Imagery - Sailors lift the framing for a wall during reconstruction in Louisiana..jpg
candidats.description: BURAS, La. (April 12, 2011) Sailors assigned to Naval Air Station Joint Reserve Base New Orleans, Fleet Logistics Support Squadron (VR) 54, and Fleet Readiness Center Mid-Atlantic New Orleans Detachment, lift the framing for a wall during reconstruction of Peter Bay Le’s home. Le was a South Vietnamese army officer during the Vietnam War and a prisoner of war before immigrating to the U.S. The Navy partnered with The United Way and The Fuller Center for Housing Disaster ReBuilders to rebuild Le’s home. The house was destroyed during Hurricane Katrina in 2005. (U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communica
